name: Rail Dispatcher
description: Build a railway with track, switches, platforms and signals, run lines on it and watch the automatic dispatcher route trains. Find the bottlenecks and how many trains each line can take.
controls: Drag to pan, wheel/pinch to zoom · 1–5 tools: select, track (drag between grid points), station, signal (tap), erase · Space pause · U usage map · Ctrl+Z undo
